content.text: Jump to content From Simple English Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia CatherineDeveloper(s)AtlusPublisher(s)AtlusArtist(s)Shigenori SoejimaComposer(s)Shoji Meguro EngineGamebryo Platform(s)Microsoft WindowsNintendo Switchpersonal computerPlayStation 3PlayStation 4PlayStation VitaXbox 360 ReleaseFebruary 14, 2011 (Japan) July 26, 2011 (America)Genre(s)Puzzle PlatformerMode(s)Multiplayersingle-player Catherine (キャサリン, Kyasarin) is a video game created by the game developer, Atlus. it was originally released in 2011 for the PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360. it would get a remake in 2019 called Catherine: Full Body (キャサリン：フルボディ, Kyasarin: Furubodi)[1] that was first announced in 2017 and was released on consoles such as the Nintendo Switch.[2] The original game was re-released on the website, Steam on January 10th, 2019 and was renamed as "Catherine Classic".[3][4] Premise[change | change source] The game is about the relationships of 3 characters, Vincent Brooks, Katherine McBride and a 23-year-old woman named Catherine[5] Characters[change | change source] Vincent Brooks Katherine McBride Catherine References[change | change source] ↑ "キャサリン・フルボディ - 公式サイト". キャサリン・フルボディ - 公式サイト (in Japanese).
